name: LAION-400M
description: A dataset of approximately 400 million image-text pairs collected from web-accessible sources and filtered using CLIP-based similarity. LAION-400M is a URL index with metadata, not a redistribution of the referenced image files.
citation: Schuhmann, C., et al. (2021). LAION-400M: Open Dataset of CLIP-Filtered 400 Million Image-Text Pairs. arXiv:2111.02114. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2111.02114

license.identifier: Not stated (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: LAION-400M provides URLs and associated metadata, not the image content itself, and does not grant rights to the images or captions. Referenced material may be subject to third-party copyright, licenses, and site terms; assess the rights and terms for each source before access, use, or redistribution. This record is URL-index-only and vendors no data.
